001: Good morning, Lucas. You look great today.
Thanks, Ana! I finally managed to sleep well last night.
That's great! I didn't sleep at all, I'm feeling very tired.
Oh, that's too bad. Do you have a headache?
Yes, I do, and I also have a slight fever.
Maybe you need to rest today and drink plenty of water.
002: Gabriel, you have a terrible cough. Do you have the flu?
I think so. It started yesterday with a sore throat.
Have you taken any medicine for it?
I took some syrup, but it hasn't done much yet.
If it keeps up like this, you should go to the doctor.
You're right. I'll make an appointment for tomorrow.
003: Fernanda, do you have an allergy? Your eyes are red.
I can't stop sneezing. I think it's because of the dust.
That happens to me too when the weather gets dry.
What do you usually take to feel better?
I use an antihistamine that the doctor prescribed for me.
I'll ask my doctor for a prescription too.
004: Rafael, do you have a stomachache? You look terrible.
I have a very strong pain. I think I ate something spoiled.
Can you tell me exactly where it hurts?
It's right here, on the right side, near my belly.
That could be something serious. You should go to the emergency room.
Can you come with me? I'm afraid to drive like this.
005: Camila, how long have you had that shoulder pain?
It's been over a week now. It's even hard to sleep.
Have you done any repetitive strain recently?
I spent the whole weekend carrying boxes during the move.
That explains the pain. You need to do physical therapy.
The doctor already recommended a good physical therapist to me. I'll start next week.
006: Felipe, are you feeling dizzy? You look pale.
I'm feeling a bit weak and slightly dizzy.
I only had a coffee in the morning and haven't eaten anything since.
That's dangerous. You need to eat something right now.
I'll eat some fruit and see if I feel better.
007: Beatriz, do you have a fever? Your forehead is hot.
Yes, I do, and I also have chills.
Have you taken your temperature yet?
Not yet, but I'm feeling very hot.
Let me see if we have a thermometer here.
Thanks. If the fever is high, I'll need to go to the doctor.
008: Lucas, do you have a backache? You're moving strangely.
Yes, I do. I made a wrong move at the gym yesterday.
I can, but it hurts a lot when I bend down.
You should apply ice to the area to reduce the inflammation.
Good idea. I'll do that as soon as I get home.
009: Fernanda, do you have an earache? You keep putting your hand on it.
I've had a very strong pain since last night.
Have you been to an ear, nose, and throat doctor?
Not yet. I'm trying to make an appointment, but it's hard.
If the pain is unbearable, go to the emergency room.
You're right. I'll wait until the end of the day, and if it doesn't get better, I'll go.
010: Gabriel, do you have chest pain? That's worrying.
It's a mild pain, but it shows up when I exercise.
Have you ever had any heart tests done?
I never have. I'm a little afraid of finding out something.
Don't be afraid. It's better to know early than to find out late.
You're right. I'll make an appointment with a cardiologist as soon as possible.
